summary: Phase 2 (Super Admin + approval + status gating) fully tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passing in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_platform.py — platform login (success/401/429 brute force), role separation (platform token -> 403 on CRM, CRM token -> 403 on /platform/*, no token -> 401), request-access (invalid CNPJ 400, pending creation returning {status:pending, shop_code}, duplicate 400), status gating (pending owner can login & /auth/me shows shop_status='pending', CRM endpoints 403, /auth/register on non-active 403), decisions (stats, list with masked CPF, detail unmasked, approve->active + decision_history entry, suspend->blocks client login + /auth/me suspended + CRM 403, reactivate restores), Phase-1 isolation preserved (two active shops don't share barbers, cross-shop PUT -> 404), super admin idempotence (/platform/me returns configured email), DEMO01 remains active, autopromotion blocked (PUT /api/clients role field is ignored and role stays 'client'). Frontend: /plataforma login works and routes to /plataforma/painel; platform-stats, 5 platform-filter-* buttons, platform-shops-table, platform-logout-btn all present; CPF list column is masked. Login screen 'Solicitar acesso' opens form with shop-name-input + cpf-cnpj-input; submitting a valid fresh CNPJ shows pending-request-box with the generated shop_code (observed 41CBX9) and pending-back-btn returns to login. Pending owner logging in via UI lands on shop-status-screen with status-logout-btn — not on CRM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1130 lines — still single file. Consider splitting into routers (auth, platform, crm resources) before next feature phase.
update_client accepts the full ClientIn body (name/phone/notes used, role not even in schema — good, autopromotion is blocked by schema). Make sure any future ClientIn fields keep role out.
DEMO01 is 'active' in preview but 'pending' in production via shop_status() fallback. OK for current preview tests but document this so prod seed does not surprise ops.

Super admin creation is idempotent on insert; however, if SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD env is ever rotated, the stored hash is NOT updated (comment explicitly says 'never reset here'). This is intentional for safety but worth highlighting in ops docs.
List endpoint /api/platform/shops iterates all shops in Python to filter by status + q — fine for current scale but should become a Mongo query ({status: ...} + text index) as count grows.
